premise: Flower grows tallest in the patch and her shadow falls on Mushroom; when Snail points it out, she learns to lean so the sun reaches everyone.
inspiration: The Oak and the Reed (La Fontaine), turned: bending is not weakness but kindness, and the tall one chooses it.
lesson: Being tall is best when you share the light.

en-US.title: Flower Leans Over
en-US.text: {flower:sway loop 0.4} {butterfly:float loop 0.4} Flower grew, and grew, and grew. She was the tallest in the whole patch. Look at me! she said, and {flower:pulse} {flower:glow} turned her big yellow face up to the sun. Ahh. Down below, in her shadow, sat Mushroom. Mushroom said nothing. Mushroom was shy. Snail came sliding past. He looked at Flower, up in the sun. He looked at Mushroom, down in the shade. {snail:pulse} Hmm, said Snail. Flower? Flower looked down. Oh, she said. Oh dear. She hadn't seen. So Flower did something flowers don't often do. She {flower:sway 0.9} leaned. Just a little. Then a little more. And a stripe of sunshine slid across the moss and landed, warm as a hand, on Mushroom's cap. {mushroom:glow} Mushroom went pink. {mushroom:tint #F7B7C8} Thank you, she whispered. Flower stayed leaning all afternoon. It was a funny way to stand. But the sun felt better shared. {flower:hearts} Much better.

es-ES.title: Flor se inclina
es-ES.text: {flower:sway loop 0.4} {butterfly:float loop 0.4} Flor creció, y creció, y creció. Era la más alta de todo el rincón. ¡Miradme!, dijo, y {flower:pulse} {flower:glow} levantó su gran cara amarilla hacia el sol. Ahh. Abajo, en su sombra, estaba Seta. Seta no dijo nada. Seta era tímida. Caracol pasó deslizándose. Miró a Flor, arriba, al sol. Miró a Seta, abajo, a la sombra. {snail:pulse} Mmm, dijo Caracol. ¿Flor? Flor miró hacia abajo. Oh, dijo. Ay, no. No se había dado cuenta. Entonces Flor hizo algo que las flores no suelen hacer. {flower:sway 0.9} Se inclinó. Solo un poco. Luego un poco más. Y una franja de sol resbaló por el musgo y se posó, cálida como una mano, en el sombrero de Seta. {mushroom:glow} Seta se puso colorada. {mushroom:tint #F7B7C8} Gracias, susurró. Flor se quedó inclinada toda la tarde. Era una manera rara de estar. Pero el sol sabía mejor compartido. {flower:hearts} Mucho mejor.
